Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a finished full-body transparent character portrait for the CosyWorld Greek drama game, The Wine-Dark Sea.
Primary request: ANTiGONE reimagined in a CHThONIC GREEK visual style, a solemn human presence at the threshold of the underworld. Original painterly dark Hellenic fantasy, tactile oil-painted brushwork, convincing adult anatomy and expressive face, inspired by weathered funerary sculpture, faded Greek wall painting, burial earth and the dark water of an underground river. Richly realized, not flat vector art.
Subject: Antigone, an adult woman in her mid twenties with warm olive-brown skin, strong aquiline features, dark deep-set eyes and unruly black curls partly beneath a worn mantle. She looks resolutely toward the left, mournful and courageous rather than glamorous. Dust-stained simple linen chiton, charcoal and dried pomegranate-red wool mantle, a small dull bronze clasp, worn leather sandals. Her clothes are practical ancient Greek drapery, their folds sculptural and weighty. Bare hands lightly stained with grave earth; one holds the edge of her mantle at her waist, the other hangs naturally. No carried inventory item.
Composition: one single isolated character, standing in a calm readable pose, full body from the complete crown of her head to both sandal soles, three-quarter view facing LEFT, near eye level, tall portrait canvas, comfortable transparent space around every edge, consistent game portrait framing. Keep both feet and all hair fully within frame.
Lighting/mood: dim amber oil-lamp light across her face and hands, a restrained cool mineral-green rim light catching the silhouette as if reflected from subterranean water. Deep shadows but readable facial features and garments; earthly grief, ritual dignity, quiet defiance. Colors: soot black, burial umber, pomegranate oxblood, tarnished bronze, small bone-linen accents. No magical particles, no flames, no glow effects, no throne, no architecture, no scenery, no ground plane.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no checkerboard painted in, no text, no labels, no frame, no watermark. This is an original mature Greek tragic heroine, not a generic fantasy witch, armored warrior, or glamorous goddess.
